notes.subject: אהביה
notes.rationale: Ketiv אהביה (participle + feminine suffix, 'her lovers') vs qere אהבי ('my lovers'); rendered per the qere.

notes.subject: אהביה / אהב
notes.rationale: Root אהב repeated in participial and finite form — love answered with love — a repetition English only partly carries.

notes.subject: wisdom's invitation
notes.rationale: Lady Wisdom speaks in the first person, addressing those who would love and seek her.

translation: I, those who love me — I love them, and those who seek me early find me.

tokens.gloss: and those who seek me early
